name: multi-app-platform
description: MERN stack multi-app platform with cross-subdomain SSO

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../dashboard-service && npm install && cd ../store-service && npm install && cd ../../apps/main-app && npm install && cd ../dashboard-app && npm install && cd ../store-app && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:store" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:dashboard-app" "npm run dev:store-app"
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:services: cd services/auth-service && npm run build && cd ../dashboard-service && npm run build && cd ../store-service && npm run build
scripts.build:apps: cd apps/main-app && npm run build && cd ../dashboard-app && npm run build && cd ../store-app && npm run build
